review_notes: Atomic timestamp roles, 60-second margins and flow-end containment verified.
Synthetic CSV integration confirms that A/B calibration and common future test are excluded from fitting. B fitting population includes A; capped sample membership need not be nested.
Deterministic BottomK preserves row identity and chunk-order invariance; the union of local bottom-K samples yields the global bottom-K sample.
Threshold calibration uses runtime float32 scores, strict floating comparison and finite 0..1 endpoints; an always-normal operating point is permitted.
Integer threshold transfer preserves logit units and always-normal/always-attack endpoints; raw integer-code staleness is labelled separately.
Primary test retains all eligible rows. Conflicting labels retain proportional contributions. Row, vector and capped weights were checked against explicit weighted rows.
The selected future test has no known-A attack group; four-way attack coverage is not claimed.
Confidence intervals are suppressed on the selected four test days. Leave-one-day-out sensitivity is descriptive and is not a confidence interval.
Quantizer ranges and normalization use fitting samples only; operating-point selection uses calibration normals only. All fixed model families are reported.
